headline: La Pampa announces fiscal and financial incentives to attract Vaca Muerta investments
summary: The Argentine province of La Pampa announced provincial tax exemptions, 15 years of fiscal stability, and a 500-hectare logistics hub in 25 de Mayo to attract investments tied to Vaca Muerta.
why: Vaca Muerta is a massive shale oil and gas reserve in Argentina whose development requires substantial infrastructure and capital investments.
